title: UN Secretary-General Guterres Calls October 7 'Abhorrent' at UNGA, Then Condemns Israel's Gaza Campaign as Unprecedented in Scale
detail: UN Secretary-General António Guterres, addressing the opening of the General Debate of the 81st UN General Assembly session in New York on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, said it is 'nearly three years since the abhorrent terror attacks by Hamas on 7 October,' but that what followed was 'an onslaught on Palestinians in Gaza' with 'a scale of killing and destruction' he had not witnessed in all his years as Secretary-General. Guterres also warned that Israeli violence, displacement and settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank were 'bulldozing the path to peace' and raising the 'spectre of ethnic cleansing,' and cited the International Court of Justice's provisional measures in the genocide case against Israel, saying all parties must comply with the Court's orders. The remarks came on the first day of the annual General Debate, days ahead of the third anniversary of the October 7 attack, and drew immediate pushback from the Israeli delegation, which had earlier walked out of the hall during other leaders' remarks.

title: Syrian President al-Sharaa: 'Not Appropriate' That October 7 Sets Israel's Syria Policy, Says Talks Reached Nearly 90% Agreement
detail: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, speaking at an Atlantic Council panel on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, said 'it is not appropriate that what happened on October 7 sets the policy for Syria,' adding 'this is not logical, and this brings more security threats.' Al-Sharaa argued Israel's post-October-7 security posture was 'creating problems around it in order to maintain its security, and this is not working,' while separately disclosing that direct Syria-Israel negotiations, conducted with American involvement, had at one point reached 'almost 90%' agreement, though he cautioned 'we are not saying that there will be lasting peace right now.' The remarks were his most direct public linkage yet of October 7's lasting influence on Israeli threat perception to the stalled state of Syrian-Israeli normalization talks.
